The refactoring is complete. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Class moves (via `git mv`, preserving history)

| Class | Old location | New location |
|---|---|---|
| `HFileBootstrapIndex` | `hudi-common/…/common/bootstrap/index/` | `hudi-hadoop-common/…/common/bootstrap/index/hfile/` (pkg `…bootstrap.index.hfile`) |
| `HoodieHFileUtils` | `hudi-common/…/io/storage/` | `hudi-hadoop-common/…/io/hadoop/` (pkg `…io.hadoop`) |
| `HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader` | `hudi-common/…/io/storage/` | `hudi-hadoop-common/…/io/hadoop/` (pkg `…io.hadoop`) |

## Constructor simplification (`HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader`)
Replaced the five `CacheConfig`-taking constructors with the two requested public ones plus a private delegate. The `CacheConfig` is now built internally (`new CacheConfig(storageConf.unwrapAs(Configuration.class))`), so callers no longer supply it:
- `HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader(StorageConfiguration<?>, StoragePath, Option<Schema>)`
- `HoodieHBaseAvroHFileReader(StorageConfiguration<?>, StoragePath, HoodieStorage, byte[], Option<Schema>)`

## Supporting changes
- **`HoodieAvroHFileReaderImplBase`**: made the inherited `SeekableByteArrayInputStream` `public` — it was package-private, and `HoodieHFileUtils` now lives in a different package (`io.hadoop`) yet still references it.
- **`HoodieAvroFileReaderFactory`** (same new package): dropped the same-package import and the `CacheConfig`/`Configuration`/`HoodieStorageUtils` usage; now calls the new constructors.
- **`HoodieBootstrapConfig`** (client-common) and **`HoodieStreamer`** (utilities): updated imports to the new `…bootstrap.index.hfile` package (both modules already depend on `hudi-hadoop-common`).
- **`BootstrapCommand`** (CLI): updated the default-value string literal to the new FQN.

## Dependency-direction handling
`hudi-common` cannot depend on `hudi-hadoop-common`, so the two `hudi-common` files that referenced `HFileBootstrapIndex.class.getName()` — **`BootstrapIndexType`** and **`HoodieTableConfig`** — now use the string literal `"org.apache.hudi.common.bootstrap.index.hfile.HFileBootstrapIndex"` instead of importing the moved class.
